title: surface-bridge-messages v1
description: The one definition of the messages that cross a surface's bridge: surfaces/bridge-messages.json. Each of the three shapes - a page's request, Horde's reply, an event Horde pushes - maps the part a member plays to its name on the wire. surfaces/Port.ps1 adds the rules a schema cannot say: within a shape no two parts share a name, and a reply and an event can be told apart by the one member each has that the other has not.

protocol.description: The version of the shapes. Both sides send it and refuse any other.

id.description: A whole number from 1 up that the page chose; the reply carries it back.

name.description: Which request of the bridge's closed list.

arguments.description: An object of the arguments that request declared; may be left out when it takes none.

reply.description: What Horde answers a request with: ok and value, or not ok and reason.

id.description: The id of the request this answers.

event.description: What Horde pushes without being asked.

name.description: Which event of the bridge's declared list.
